pages.text: Returns the milliseconds of a time (0 to 999).$(br2)Without $(1)time$() the function uses the current time. It uses the time zone of the server.
$(li)$(1)time$() TIME: the time (optional, default now)$(li)result $(1)result$() INTEGER: the millisecond, 0 to 999
$(1)CALL c0de/time/MILLISECOND$(br)  PARAMETER time start ;$(br)  RESULT result millis$()
